stance_rationale: Core alpha_scores extension evidence exists, but the package's key retain/comparison claims are not yet forge-grade: baseline fairness, DSR/Harvey completeness, target artifact lineage, and S3-vs-S4 admission lineage all need correction before approval.

critical_concerns.description: phase3_4_comparison imports WT-T20260508_004 documented metrics as the lockbox baseline and compares a 256-month baseline ending 2026-05 against a 255-month updated path ending 2026-04. No same-period, same-cost, same-DSR recomputation is shown, so the S4 retain delta is not a fair Forge comparison.

The package reports STR_1715 5/5 Harvey and DSR_post, but the 5-family S0-S4 outputs only provide Sharpe/CAGR/MDD/turnover. Per-family CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR are absent, and baseline DSR is not applied.

The requested WT-T20260509_001 weights.csv and both requested stage artifact directories are missing. The actual alpha_scores/covariance live under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010, so the worktask is not self-contained and the role checklist cannot verify the requested schedule/artifact paths.

WT-T20260508_004 states S3_Hybrid_70_15_15 retain/admit, while this draft reframes current_admit and next_step as S4_Hybrid_50_25_25 retain. That admission-label shift is not backed by a challenge note or independent verification.

STR_1715 run_all uses L1/2 turnover with cost multiplied by 2 for round-trip trading, while phase2_5family_backtest applies COST_PER_DOLLAR without the x2 multiplier and also consumes already-net STR_1715 returns. Same-cost comparability and turnover cap accounting are therefore not traceable.

supporting_arguments: Actual alpha_scores.parquet under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010 has 79,835 rows, 268 sig_dates, and Date range 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01.
Actual covariance.parquet under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010 is symmetric PSD with min eigenvalue 0.003300941871 and condition number 24.34, under the post-shrink cond <= 100 target.
STR_1715 log shows 267 walk-forward periods, annual turnover about 515.4%, and MDD -40.74%, passing the hard turnover and MDD caps at the base sleeve level.
Charts required by RF-F8 are present: equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the task intentionally waives frozen lockbox extension; the role prompt requires frozen extension evidence, but the package says frozen is discarded for this operational WT.

Whether phase1c direct fwrite after Backtest Result Contract failure is acceptable, given 02_nav.csv and 03_period_returns.csv changed while 06_metrics.csv, 04_holdings.csv, 10_audit.csv, and bt_result.rds remained unchanged.
Whether S3 or S4 is the actual 6/1 effective admitted allocation.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that S4_Hybrid_50_25_25 can be retained based on a documented, non-same-period baseline comparison, despite predecessor lineage naming S3 as the retained admit.
rebuttal_required: Recompute S0-S4 baseline over exactly 2005-02 to 2026-04 with identical 15bps cost and identical DSR penalty.
Provide per-family CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, FF6 t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR for updated and baseline paths.
Create or explicitly redirect the missing WT-T20260509_001 weights.csv and requested stage artifact directories with md5 lineage.
Reconcile S3 vs S4 admission lineage in a challenge_note and cite the approving source.
Document one turnover convention and rerun family metrics if cost treatment changes.
rationalization_red_flags: OOS 28m 구간 alpha 효과 매우 강력

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge evidence is directionally useful but not approval-grade until same-period baseline, DSR/5-spec, artifact lineage, and admission lineage are independently verifiable.
